A bill for an act relating to education; requiring student teacher placement within certain distance; removing requirements for a teacher candidate performance assessment; requiring rulemaking.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+TEACHER CANDIDATE PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT; RULEMAKING. +]

[+Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board must discontinue requiring parts, portions, tasks, or the totality of the edTPA performance assessment to be completed by teacher candidates. The board must amend Minnesota Rules, part 8705.2100, to remove requirements for the performance assessment. +]

Sec. 2. [+STUDENT TEACHER PLACEMENT; RULEMAKING. +]

[+The Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board must amend Minnesota Rules, part 8705.1010, to require a student teacher to be placed within 30 miles of their preferred location or school site unless the teacher preparatory program and teacher candidate mutually agree to a placement further away from the teacher candidate's preferred location. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring student teacher placement within certain distance; removing requirements for a teacher candidate performance assessment; requiring rulemaking.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TEACHER CANDIDATE PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT; RULEMAKING.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board must discontinue requiring parts, portions, tasks, or the totality of the edTPA performance assessment to be completed by teacher candidates. The board must amend Minnesota Rules, part 8705.2100, to remove requirements for the performance assessment.

Sec. 2. STUDENT TEACHER PLACEMENT; RULEMAKING.

The Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board must amend Minnesota Rules, part 8705.1010, to require a student teacher to be placed within 30 miles of their preferred location or school site unless the teacher preparatory program and teacher candidate mutually agree to a placement further away from the teacher candidate's preferred location.
additions: Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board must discontinue requiring parts, portions, tasks, or the totality of the edTPA performance assessment to be completed by teacher candidates. The board must amend Minnesota Rules, part 8705.2100, to remove requirements for the performance assessment.

The Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board must amend Minnesota Rules, part 8705.1010, to require a student teacher to be placed within 30 miles of their preferred location or school site unless the teacher preparatory program and teacher candidate mutually agree to a placement further away from the teacher candidate's preferred location.
